purpose: Repair exactly V6A4-AUD-B001 through V6A4-AUD-B007 without changing any V4 scientific, case, count, denial, transaction-member, directory-intent, fallback, role-set or no-evidence semantic that passed audit.

superseded_surfaces_exact: V4 audit-time auditor identity and future-role comparison timing
claim/publication checkpoint and incident routing completeness
two composite materialized-schema projections and their hash domains
FlushFileBuffers handle access and nonmutation attestation

normative_precedence: V5 replaces only the seven superseded surfaces. For those surfaces V5 is controlling and conjunctive; elsewhere exact-hash V4 remains controlling. Any ambiguity, missing join, unenumerated raw outcome, unresolved pointer, path/hash mismatch, favorable normalization or representation conflict is FAIL_BLOCKING. A passing surface cannot compensate for a failed surface.

path_registry_extension.source_alias_rule: source:* tokens are document-internal source artifact aliases only and are never serialized as BINDING_V4.path_id or access-row PATH_ID values. Every binding/access row uses the mapped inherited registered PATH_ID; its bytes/SHA must equal source_bindings for that alias.
path_registry_extension.path_rule: All four V5 relative paths are normalized under campaign_root, are pairwise distinct, are absent before their one authorized CREATE_NEW writer, and are never overwritten, appended, renamed, deleted or reused. V4 path_registry remains inherited for all source and Stage-A-through-D paths.

preserved_noncompensatory_invariants.directory_intents_and_fallbacks: 37 exact intents and the disjoint 8/29/0 fallback partition remain byte-semantic unchanged from V4
preserved_noncompensatory_invariants.transaction_and_membership: four transactions, 32 rename pairs, success/failure ledgers, bounded membership and nonrecursive publication semantics remain unchanged except the exact seven repairs
preserved_noncompensatory_invariants.no_evidence_rule: No V5 addendum, audit, activation, role freeze, schema, identity tuple, process outcome, checkpoint ledger, read attestation, projection record, flush observation, receipt or acceptance is scientific evidence or may support a claim, gate, grade, advancement or human transfer.

ordered_gates: G0: immutable V5 bytes at static:v5
G1: independent ROLE_V5_AMENDMENT_AUDITOR writes static:v5_audit with complete audit-time identity tuple and PASS_ZERO_BLOCKING_ZERO_UNRESOLVED
G2: distinct Root writes static:v5_activation after exact auditor-to-Root identity comparison
G3: Root writes static:v5_role_assignment_freeze with exact 18 assignments, 153 assignment-joined conflict rows and 18 auditor-to-role comparisons
G4: V4 Stage A through D may proceed only under V5 effective schema/access/state overrides and all unchanged V4 gates
route.audit_time_future_identity_rule: G1 binds only the auditor's complete tuple. It must not assert comparison with a not-yet-assigned Root or operational role. Root comparison occurs only at G2; the exact 18 future-role comparisons occur only at G3.
route.failure_rule: Failure or uncertainty at any gate leaves every later gate denied. No earlier V4 FAIL receipt can be reinterpreted as PASS.

audit_time_contract.tuple_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of all six fields in identity_dimensions_in_exact_order
audit_time_contract.pass_scope: V5 bytes, seven repair predicates, full auditor tuple completeness and internal consistency only

activation_time_contract.auditor_binding: exact static:v5_audit auditor tuple and tuple hash
activation_time_contract.comparison_rule: one IDENTITY_DIMENSION_COMPARISON_V5 row per dimension in exact order; left is auditor, right is Root, both values join their tuples and equal_boolean is false
activation_time_contract.root_future_assignment_rule: The later role-freeze Root assignment must byte-equal this activation-time Root tuple.

role_freeze_contract.assignment_join_rule: Every conflict row left/right role index, role ID, actor ID, tuple hash and all six comparison values equal the referenced ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_V5 rows exactly.
role_freeze_contract.unique_pair_rule: All pair_index and pair_key values are unique; every unordered i<j pair occurs exactly once; reversed/self pairs are invalid.
role_freeze_contract.dimension_rule: Each of the 153 rows has exactly six ordered comparison rows and every equal_boolean is false.
role_freeze_contract.auditor_join_rule: Row k joins the V5 audit tuple on the left and assignment[k] on the right, carries all six exact values, and every equal_boolean is false.
role_freeze_contract.root_join_rule: assignment[17] is ROLE_ROOT_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_V4 and its full tuple and tuple hash equal the V5 activation Root tuple exactly.

classification_table.NOT_CALLED_PRESTART_FAILURE: NOT_STARTED_PROVEN with attempted=false and every return/process field null
classification_table.RETURNED_FALSE: NOT_STARTED_PROVEN only with attempted=true, return_boolean=false, GetLastError captured and every process identity field null
classification_table.RETURNED_TRUE: STARTED_PROVEN only with attempted=true, return_boolean=true, GetLastError null, nonzero PID/TID, both handle identities and matching_process_observation=true
classification_table.RETURNED_TRUE_THEN_CONTROLLER_INTERRUPTE: STARTED_PROVEN only when the complete RETURNED_TRUE proof tuple is durably observable; otherwise the raw state is CALL_ENTERED_NO_DURABLE_RETURN_OBSERVATION and class UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVELY_SPENT

process_start_repair.unknown_rule: Any controller crash, no-return, torn return record, conflicting PID/TID/handle observation or inability to prove NOT_STARTED or STARTED is CALL_ENTERED_NO_DURABLE_RETURN_OBSERVATION and UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVELY_SPENT. It is never normalized to false, is always spent, requires incident routing and cannot be retried. Every realized object matches exactly one conditional_rows_exact row.
process_start_repair.boolean_replacement_rule: INCIDENT_RECEIPT_V4.worker_process_start_boolean is removed from the effective schema. PROCESS_START_OUTCOME_V5 is required and no Boolean alias or inference is permitted.

normalization_rows_in_priority_order.predicate: controller_interruption_observed_boolean=false AND api_call_state=ENTERED AND api_return_state=EXPLICIT_FAILURE AND mutation_state=NONE_PROVEN AND postcondition_state=PROVEN_UNCHANGED_FAILURE
controller_interruption_observed_boolean=false AND api_call_state=ENTERED AND api_return_state=EXPLICIT_SUCCESS AND postcondition_state=PROVEN_SUCCESS

crash_and_incident_state_repair.normalization_rule: Populate RAW_CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATION_V5 from durable observations without inference, evaluate normalization_rows_in_priority_order from priority 1 upward, and select the first matching row exactly once. Later rows are not evaluated after a match. Thus an observed controller interruption dominates no-return, a non-interrupted entered call with no durable return is CALL_ENTERED_NO_DURABLE_RETURN_OBSERVATION, and every remaining missing/conflicting tuple is the priority-6 POSTCONDITION_UNCERTAIN catch-all. No favorable selection or synonym exists.

state_predicates_exact.READY_DURABLE_UNCLAIMED: READY present exact and CLAIMED absent before C2; no claim API entered
state_predicates_exact.CLAIM_EXPLICIT_FAILURE_UNCHANGED_READY_U: C2 returned explicit failure; READY exact identity/hash unchanged; CLAIMED absent; authorization unspent; no worker
state_predicates_exact.CLAIM_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_SPENT: C2 entered but explicit unchanged-READY proof is absent, partial, conflicting or no-return; authorization spent; no retry
state_predicates_exact.CLAIMED_DURABLE_HANDOFF_ABSENT_SPENT: C3 proves READY absent and CLAIMED present exact; handoff not yet present; authorization spent
state_predicates_exact.CLAIMED_HANDOFF_DURABLE_PRESTART_SPENT: C4 proves exact final handoff; CreateProcessW not yet entered; authorization spent
state_predicates_exact.PROCESS_START_NOT_STARTED_PROVEN_SPENT: C5 PROCESS_START_OUTCOME_V5 is NOT_STARTED_PROVEN after claim; authorization spent; no retry
state_predicates_exact.PROCESS_START_UNKNOWN_SPENT: C5 PROCESS_START_OUTCOME_V5 is UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVELY_SPENT; authorization spent; no retry
state_predicates_exact.WORKER_STARTED_PROVEN_SPENT: C5 PROCESS_START_OUTCOME_V5 is STARTED_PROVEN and no controller interruption has yet been selected
state_predicates_exact.STAGED_SUCCESS_SELECTED_SPENT: P1 proves exactly complete success staging and selects SUCCESS; failure staging absent
state_predicates_exact.STAGED_FAILURE_SELECTED_SPENT: P1 proves exactly complete failure staging and selects FAILURE; success staging is absent or only the V4-authorized incomplete nonauthoritative partial tree
state_predicates_exact.TERMINAL_RENAME_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_SPENT: Selected P2 rename/flush/validation call entered but its required terminal postconditions are not all proven
state_predicates_exact.TERMINAL_RENAMED_ATTESTATION_ABSENT_SPEN: P3 proves selected staging absent, terminal destination present with exact identity/membership/hashes, and publication attestation absent
state_predicates_exact.PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_PRESENT_PENDING_: P4 write-through attestation rename returned success and the final attestation path is present; P5 full validation pending
state_predicates_exact.PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_RENAME_OUTCOME_U: P4 construction/rename entered but exact final attestation absence/presence and identity cannot all be proven
state_predicates_exact.COMMITTED_SUCCESS_DURABLE_PENDING_AUDIT: P5 validates SUCCESS terminal bundle and exact publication attestation; downstream independent result audit remains required
state_predicates_exact.COMMITTED_FAILURE_DURABLE: P5 validates FAILURE terminal bundle and exact publication attestation; invocation permanently nonauthoritative
state_predicates_exact.ILLEGAL_SPLIT_STATE: Observed tuple is outside every legal checkpoint partition or has simultaneous/contradictory roots; conservatively spent and incident-contained
state_predicates_exact.INCIDENT_REQUIRED_SPENT: First failed checkpoint has an exact nonnull trigger not assigned a more specific uncertainty state; authorization spent and incident closeout required
state_predicates_exact.INCIDENT_CLOSED_REJECTED: Required incident bundle is independently exact-open validated; invocation remains permanently rejected and confers no authority

crash_and_incident_state_repair.state_partition_rule: state_predicates_exact and state_ids_exact have identical key sets and order. At any observation boundary exactly one predicate may hold. A tuple matching zero or more than one predicate is ILLEGAL_SPLIT_STATE, never an inferred success.

checkpoint_outcome_partition.C1_C3_C4_P2S_P2F_P3_P4_P5_rule: At the named checkpoint EXPLICIT_SUCCESS_POSTCONDITIONS_PROVEN alone takes the displayed success edge. Every one of the five ordinary_failure_tokens_exact takes that checkpoint's single displayed failure trigger/state; no token is dropped or normalized favorably.
checkpoint_outcome_partition.C2_rule: EXPLICIT_SUCCESS_POSTCONDITIONS_PROVEN takes C3; EXPLICIT_FAILURE_PROVEN_NO_MUTATION takes CLAIM_EXPLICIT_FAILURE_UNCHANGED_READY_UNSPENT only when READY exact bytes/hash/file-ID/volume are unchanged and CLAIMED is absent; each of the remaining four failure tokens takes C2_CLAIM_RENAME_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN and CLAIM_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_SPENT.
checkpoint_outcome_partition.C5_rule: The required PROCESS_START_OUTCOME_V5 conditional row is controlling: NOT_STARTED_PROVEN takes its displayed spent trigger/state, UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVELY_SPENT takes its displayed spent trigger/state, uninterrupted STARTED_PROVEN takes WORKER_STARTED_PROVEN_SPENT, and RETURNED_TRUE_THEN_CONTROLLER_INTERRUPTED takes C5_STARTED_CONTROLLER_INTERRUPTED and INCIDENT_REQUIRED_SPENT.
checkpoint_outcome_partition.P1_rule: EXPLICIT_SUCCESS_POSTCONDITIONS_PROVEN is valid only with exactly one complete branch: SUCCESS takes P2S/STAGED_SUCCESS_SELECTED_SPENT and FAILURE takes P2F/STAGED_FAILURE_SELECTED_SPENT. Zero, two, incomplete, UNKNOWN, or any ordinary failure token takes P1_WORKER_EXIT_OR_BRANCH_SELECTION_INVALID_OR_CRASH and INCIDENT_REQUIRED_SPENT.
checkpoint_outcome_partition.illegal_split_rule: Any tuple outside these exact partitions, any impossible simultaneous state, branch mismatch, missing required proof, duplicate first failure, or later checkpoint entry maps only to ILLEGAL_SPLIT_STATE trigger/state and is conservatively spent. It cannot be assigned to an ordinary success or failure row.

crash_and_incident_state_repair.trigger_map_totality_rule: incident_trigger_ids_exact and incident_trigger_to_state_exact have identical 14-key sets. Every P1-P5 failure, uncertainty or crash selects exactly its checkpoint trigger; ILLEGAL_SPLIT_STATE is reserved for tuples outside the exhaustive checkpoint partitions and preserves the inherited fail-closed split-state route.
crash_and_incident_state_repair.first_failure_rule: CHECKPOINT_LEDGER_V5 records the last completed checkpoint and first failed checkpoint exactly once. Once first_failed_checkpoint_or_null is nonnull, no later checkpoint may be entered or recorded. Trigger and state are the exact table lookup; later observations cannot replace the first failure.
crash_and_incident_state_repair.disjointness_rule: The pair (last_completed_checkpoint, first_failed_checkpoint_or_null, normalized_failure_outcome_or_null, selected_branch, process_start_outcome_class_or_null) matches exactly one row. P2S and P2F are mutually exclusive. Terminal-renamed-before-attestation is distinct from staged and published states. INTERRUPTED_SPENT is not a free-standing overlapping state and is superseded by the checkpoint-specific trigger/state pair.
crash_and_incident_state_repair.incident_rule: Every non-null trigger is conservatively spent except the single C2 explicit-failure-proven-no-mutation row, which has null trigger and remains the unchanged READY state. All P1 through P5 failures, uncertainties and crashes have the displayed checkpoint-specific trigger and require incident closeout.

root_staging_content_read_repair.grant_expansion_rule: For transaction T, each key resolves only to tx:T:<key>. TRANSACTION_AUTHORIZATION_V5 binds both immutable candidate arrays before the worker starts but grants no read until P1 selects exactly one branch from bounded membership. The selected array becomes Root content_read_path_ids; the other array remains denied.

read_operation_definitions.CREATEFILEW_GENERIC_READ: CreateFileW on the exact selected registered file with GENERIC_READ and no write access
read_operation_definitions.GETFILEINFORMATIONBYHANDLEEX_IDENTITY_ST: record identity, standard, reparse/tag, volume and file-ID observations
read_operation_definitions.READFILE_COMPLETE_BYTES: read exactly the complete file bytes with no truncation or extra stream
read_operation_definitions.SHA256_COMPLETE_BYTES: compute SHA-256 over exactly those complete bytes
read_operation_definitions.DEEP_JSON_SCHEMA_VALIDATION: parse and validate all fields, refs, hashes and branch-specific schema constraints
read_operation_definitions.CLOSEHANDLE: close the exact read handle and durably observe the return

read_denials: no write through a read handle
no wildcard or directory content read
no read after P2 branch completion except already-bound immutable final paths under unchanged V4 rules
root_staging_content_read_repair.attestation_rule: PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_V5 or INCIDENT_RECEIPT_V5 contains BRANCH_STAGING_READ_ATTESTATION_V5. selected_path_ids equals the selected branch expansion in exact order and has one STAGING_FILE_READ_OBSERVATION_V5 row per path. COMPLETE_VALIDATED publication requires the exact six-operation sequence and binding for every selected file. A P2 failure/crash records the exact completed contiguous prefix, one first incomplete row, and NOT_STARTED rows for every later path; it never fabricates a full binding. unselected_read_path_ids is the other exact array and unselected_read_attempt_boolean is false.
root_staging_content_read_repair.metadata_separation: V4 metadata permission remains non-content access and cannot substitute for this grant. This V5 content-read capability does not add content-write, rename, delete, execution or process-start authority.

composite_schema_materialization_repair.pointer_rule: Pointers are exact RFC6901 tokens from the arrays above. Escape processing is RFC6901 only; relative pointers, dot syntax, wildcards, arrays indexes not shown, aliases, case folding and favorable fallback are forbidden.

resolution_modes.DIRECT_VALUE: deep-copy the exact JSON value at one source pointer
resolution_modes.BASE_PLUS_OVERLAY: deep-copy base_schema_pointer from source:v4, then apply the exact ordered schema operations stored at overlay_pointer in static:v5; any missing target, prior-value mismatch or duplicate field is FAIL_BLOCKING

physical_object_equations.static:literal_audit_schema: object with fields in exact order: schema_body = resolved member 0; specializations = array [resolved member 1]; no other field
physical_object_equations.static:root_controller_schema: object with sole field schemas = array [resolved member 0, resolved member 1, resolved member 2, resolved member 3, resolved member 4, resolved member 5, resolved member 6, resolved member 7]; no other field

composite_schema_materialization_repair.container_construction_equation: Resolve every member, deep-copy its exact JSON value into the declared container_member_key, construct only the declared physical object fields in order, then canonicalize the complete object with CANONICAL_JSON_SHA256_V6. physical_bytes is the resulting UTF-8 length and physical_sha256 is SHA-256 of those exact bytes.
composite_schema_materialization_repair.unique_projection_invariant: SCHEMA_BUNDLE_V5 has exactly two PHYSICAL_PROJECTION_RECORD_V5 rows ordered by physical_path_id. Each physical_path_id occurs once. Logical members sharing a path live only inside that one record and share its one physical bytes/SHA-256 binding; no per-member row may claim equality to whole-file bytes. V4 materialization rows for these two path IDs are superseded and forbidden.
composite_schema_materialization_repair.source_member_hash_rule: For each member, source_value_bytes and source_value_sha256 are computed from the resolved member value alone. The physical record binds those member hashes plus the whole physical-file binding. Equality booleans are derived comparisons, never author assertions.
composite_schema_materialization_repair.audit_rule: Independent Stage-A audit resolves every pointer from the bound source files, reapplies overlays, reconstructs both containers, and requires exact byte-for-byte equality, physical bytes/SHA-256 equality, member hash equality, path uniqueness and inclusion of the literal-audit specialization.

flush_handle_repair.verification_handle_rule: All pre/post identity, bytes, SHA-256, membership and reparse checks use separate read/attribute handles under unchanged V4 access. No read, metadata mutation or content operation is performed through the GENERIC_WRITE flush handle.
flush_handle_repair.nonmutation_equation: pre_flush and post_flush PATH_SNAPSHOT_V4 values are identical for normalized path, kind, presence, bytes, SHA-256, volume serial, file ID, reparse and hardlink count; attempted_mutation_operations is exact empty; content_mutation_boolean is false.
flush_handle_repair.effective_scope_rule: Only ROLE_ROOT_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_V4 post-worker terminal/incident phases may open this handle for the exact V4 controller_flush_path_keys_in_exact_order expansion. Generic write access is a flush capability, not content-write_path_ids authority, and is bound in each FLUSH_HANDLE_OBSERVATION_V5.
flush_handle_repair.handle_outcome_rule: SUCCESS_HANDLE_OBSERVED requires a nonnull handle identity, actual operations exactly FlushFileBuffers then CloseHandle, and nonnull API returns. EXPLICIT_FAILURE_NO_HANDLE requires null handle, exact empty operations and null flush/close returns. CALL_ENTERED_NO_DURABLE_RETURN_OBSERVATION permits only the durably observed prefix of the two-operation list; any missing or conflicting return is DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN.
flush_handle_repair.failure_rule: Open failure/no-return, wrong mask, unexpected share/flags, any nonallowlisted operation, missing/failed FlushFileBuffers, failed/uncertain CloseHandle or pre/post snapshot difference is durability uncertainty, zero authority and checkpoint-specific incident routing.

identity_tuple_sha256.constraint: canonical SHA-256 of all six preceding fields in field_order

dimension_comparisons_in_exact_order.constraint: row d joins exact dimension d values of the indexed left/right assignment tuples

ROLE_CONFLICT_JOIN_ROW_V5.conditional_rule: The 153-row parent array is ordered by i=0..16 then j=i+1..17; every pair_index/pair_key is unique and every field joins the two indexed assignments exactly.

dimension_comparisons_in_exact_order.constraint: row d joins exact dimension d of audit auditor tuple and indexed role assignment tuple

AUDITOR_ROLE_COMPARISON_V5.conditional_rule: Parent array has one row for each role_index 0..17 in order and no duplicate; every field is an exact audit-to-assignment join.

PROCESS_START_OUTCOME_V5.conditional_rule: Exactly one process_start_repair.conditional_rows_exact row matches raw_call_state and every fixed value/proof requirement in that row. Nonapplicable nullable fields are null; partial or conflicting observations are permitted only in CALL_ENTERED_NO_DURABLE_RETURN_OBSERVATION and remain UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVELY_SPENT.

RAW_CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATION_V5.conditional_rule: api_call_state/api_return_state matches exactly one call_return_compatibility_rows_exact row; an explicit return or NO_DURABLE_RETURN can occur only with ENTERED. Conflicting raw evidence is encoded as UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN (or UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE), never as an explicit return. normalized_outcome is the unique first match under normalization_rows_in_priority_order; rows 1 through 5 dominate in order and row 6 is exhaustive catch-all.

CHECKPOINT_LEDGER_V5.conditional_rule: first_failed_checkpoint_or_null, raw_failure_observation_or_null and normalized_failure_outcome_or_null are either all null or all nonnull; when nonnull the raw checkpoint_id equals first_failed_checkpoint and normalized values are byte-equal. The tuple is one exact row under checkpoint_outcome_partition and checkpoint_policy_rows. Non-null trigger maps to selected_state_id. The sole unspent row is C2 EXPLICIT_FAILURE_PROVEN_NO_MUTATION with null trigger and unchanged READY proof; every other failed/uncertain row is spent.

completed_operations_in_exact_order.constraint: exact prefix, including empty or full, of root_staging_content_read_repair.read_operation_allowlist_exact

file_binding_or_null.constraint: nonnull only after the first four operations through SHA256_COMPLETE_BYTES have completed; when nonnull path_id equals this row path_id and binds exactly the read bytes/hash/identity

STAGING_FILE_READ_OBSERVATION_V5.conditional_rule: Let L be completed_operations length. COMPLETE_VALIDATED requires L=6, next/failure null, nonnull matching binding and deep_validation_state PASS. INCOMPLETE_FAIL_CLOSED requires L in 0..5, next_operation_index=L and nonnull failure: for L<4 binding is null and deep state NOT_REACHED; for L=4 binding is nonnull and deep state is NOT_REACHED, FAIL or UNKNOWN but not PASS; for L=5 binding is nonnull and deep state PASS, truthfully representing CloseHandle failure/no-return after successful validation. NOT_STARTED_AFTER_EARLIER_FAILURE requires L=0, next index 0, null failure/binding and NOT_REACHED. No row claims an uncompleted operation or premature binding/validation.

selected_path_ids_in_exact_order.constraint: exact selected 4-path SUCCESS or 3-path FAILURE tx:T expansion

per_path_read_observations_in_selected_p.constraint: same count and index/path order as selected_path_ids_in_exact_order

completed_read_path_ids_in_exact_order.constraint: exact contiguous selected-path prefix whose observation terminal_read_state is COMPLETE_VALIDATED

completed_file_bindings_in_exact_order.constraint: exact byte-for-byte deep copies, in order, of file_binding_or_null from the COMPLETE_VALIDATED per-path rows; no independently authored or conflicting binding value

BRANCH_STAGING_READ_ATTESTATION_V5.conditional_rule: COMPLETE_VALIDATED requires every per-path row COMPLETE_VALIDATED, all selected paths/bindings complete, and first_incomplete_index null. INCOMPLETE_FAIL_CLOSED requires first_incomplete_index equal the first non-COMPLETE row; that row is INCOMPLETE_FAIL_CLOSED and all later rows are NOT_STARTED_AFTER_EARLIER_FAILURE. The complete rows form a contiguous prefix. completed_file_bindings are canonical byte-equal extractions of the corresponding per-path bindings, not a second source of truth. No missing path, fabricated/conflicting binding, nonprefix execution or unselected access is valid.

source_artifact_sha256.constraint: exact bound source hash; static:v5 equals the V5 audit binding

SOURCE_POINTER_V5.conditional_rule: DIRECT_VALUE requires base_schema_pointer_or_null=null, overlay_pointer_or_null=null and source_artifact_id/source_pointer directly identify the value. BASE_PLUS_OVERLAY requires source_artifact_id=static:v5, source_pointer=overlay_pointer_or_null, overlay_pointer_or_null is an allowed static:v5 override pointer, and base_schema_pointer_or_null is the exact source:v4 base_source pointer stored in that override. No other tuple is valid.

source_value_bytes.constraint: canonical UTF-8 byte length of resolved source value

source_value_sha256.constraint: SHA-256 of those exact canonical source-value bytes

PROJECTION_MEMBER_V5.conditional_rule: member_index, key, logical schema key and source pointer equal the corresponding composite_schema_materialization_repair physical_projection_specs row; no member can move between physical paths.

projection_members_in_exact_order.constraint: exact member count, order and values from physical_projection_specs row

physical_file_binding.constraint: path_id equals physical_path_id and binding bytes/SHA equal reconstructed values

reconstructed_physical_sha256.constraint: SHA-256 of those exact reconstructed physical bytes

byte_equal_boolean.constraint: physical file bytes are byte-for-byte identical to reconstructed canonical bytes

PHYSICAL_PROJECTION_RECORD_V5.conditional_rule: The parent array has exactly the two physical_projection_specs rows in path order; literal member count is 2 and Root member count is 8. No per-member bytes/hash may stand in for the whole-file binding.

FLUSH_HANDLE_OBSERVATION_V5.conditional_rule: Exact flush_handle_repair flags by path_kind and handle_outcome_rule. SUCCESS_DURABLE iff handle_open_state SUCCESS_HANDLE_OBSERVED, operations are exactly [FlushFileBuffers,CloseHandle], both returns are SUCCESS, and pre/post snapshots are identical under nonmutation_equation; every other tuple is DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN.

v4_binding.constraint: path_id static:v4 and bytes/SHA equal source:v4 binding

v4_fail_audit_binding.constraint: path_id static:v4_audit and bytes/SHA equal source:v4_fail_audit binding

V5_AUDIT_RECEIPT_V5.conditional_rule: PASS requires every one of the 12 ordered checks PASS, exact empty blocking_findings and unresolved_findings, and a complete auditor identity tuple; no Root or future-role comparison field exists.
V5_AUDIT_RECEIPT_V5.hash_domain: All fields except audit_payload_hash_envelope. No Root or future operational identity comparison is present or permitted.

explicit_override_reference_reconciliati.ACCESS_ATTESTATION_V5: permitted effective target for INCIDENT_RECEIPT_V5 and PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_V5 access_attestation refs
explicit_override_reference_reconciliati.FLUSH_OBSERVATION_V4: permitted preserved effective target for ACCESS_ATTESTATION_V5 flush_observations.items_ref; that array is exact empty under V5
explicit_override_reference_reconciliati.SCHEMA_MATERIALIZATION_ENTRY_V4: permitted preserved effective target for SCHEMA_BUNDLE_V5 two remaining single-file rows via items_ref

descriptor_language.reference_rule: ref and items_ref must resolve to one of the exact 65 effective_schema_registry_contract keys. items without _ref must be one primitive token or a source:v4 compact descriptor already valid at the immutable source hash; every new or replaced schema-valued array uses items_ref.
descriptor_language.enum_source_rule: Resolve the displayed dot-separated V5 object path literally; 'plus NULL' appends JSON null exactly once. The resolved array is the complete enum, not advice.
descriptor_language.exact_values_rule: Array value and order byte-equal exact_values. exact_values_source resolves a displayed dot-separated V5 array path and requires byte-equality to that complete array. exact_count, unique_key, const, minimum, maximum and nullable are conjunctive. A type array enumerates the only allowed JSON types.
descriptor_language.unknown_descriptor_rule: Any token, ref, items_ref, enum_source, pointer or operation not resolved by these rules is FAIL_BLOCKING.

schema_classification.partition_rule: The artifact/component arrays are disjoint and their union equals every typed_schema_registry key once. All typed and effective V5 schema IDs are globally unique relative to source:v4 and one another. Artifact schemas have exactly one final nonrecursive hash envelope; component schemas have none and cannot be written alone.

effective_schema_registry_contract.construction_rule: Deep-copy the 47 source:v4 schemas; remove exactly removed_v4_keys_exact; resolve the five effective_schema_override_registry values and insert them under replacement_key_map values; insert every typed_schema_registry value under its key; reject duplicate keys or schema IDs; order all 65 keys by raw UTF-8; canonicalize the resulting object with CANONICAL_JSON_SHA256_V6.
effective_schema_registry_contract.hash_rule: SCHEMA_BUNDLE_V5 records the canonical byte count and SHA-256 of this exact 65-key object and binds static:v5. All refs resolve against this object; no implicit V4 fallback is permitted for a removed key.

effective_schema_override_registry.schema_patch_language: Each override has base_source_artifact_id=source:v4 and base_source equal to an exact RFC6901 pointer within that artifact. Exact ordered JSON object operations apply to the deep-copied value at that pointer: ADD inserts the displayed field at the exact field_order position and displayed fields key, REMOVE requires exact prior key/value class, REPLACE_FIELD requires the named field and replaces its descriptor without moving it, REPLACE_SCHEMA_ID_CONST replaces both the outer schema_id value and the fields.schema_id const when that field exists, REPLACE_SCHEMA_ID_VALUE replaces the outer component schema_id only, and REPLACE_FIELD_CONST requires the displayed prior const. Any mismatch is FAIL_BLOCKING; no URI fragment, RFC6902 extension, merge or implicit reorder exists.

TRANSACTION_AUTHORIZATION_V5.unchanged_fields_rule: Every other field, order relation, null rule and hash-domain exclusion is byte-semantic unchanged; the added field is included in the existing all-fields-except-envelope hash domain.

exact_v4_control_supersession_registry.operation_language: rows_in_finding_order are a seven-finding coverage ledger, not seven independently executable patches. finding_intent classifies the repair. Execute each nonoverlapping source pointer once and execute every overlapping or parent/child pointer only through overlap_composition_rows_exact. COMPOSITE_REPLACE replaces only the defective semantic while preserving every explicitly named unaffected V4 conjunct; AUGMENT adds an exact V5 capability without disabling the V4 base; PRESERVE_AND_BIND leaves source bytes normative and places them in a new V5 hash/projection relation. Pointer resolution is exact RFC6901. A duplicate application, missing composition row, missing pointer, extra source pointer or implicit precedence is FAIL_BLOCKING.

overlap_composition_rows_exact.effective_value_rule: The one effective V5 rule is role_identity_and_conflict_repair in full: audit-time tuple timing plus activation comparison plus the exact 18 assignments/153 joined pairs/18 auditor comparisons. Neither finding row is applied separately.

Replace the V4 terminal_state_machine once with crash_and_incident_state_repair. The former free-standing INTERRUPTED_SPENT child is not separately patched or retained; process-start uncertainty and checkpoint-specific interruption states/triggers in the V5 partition are its sole replacement.

governance_writer_and_access_contract.root_selected_branch_effective_read_rule: For transaction T, after P1 and only through its selected P2S or P2F, ROLE_ROOT_GOVERNANCE_JUDGE_V4 effective content read_path_ids equal its inherited V4 reads plus exactly tx:T:commit_staging_artifact, tx:T:commit_staging_spent, tx:T:commit_staging_success, tx:T:commit_staging_manifest for SUCCESS, or exactly tx:T:failed_staging_spent, tx:T:failed_staging_failure, tx:T:failed_staging_manifest for FAILURE. governance_writer_and_access_contract.root_flush_capability_rule: Only the inherited Root post-worker flush path expansion obtains transient GENERIC_WRITE open capability, solely for the two-call FlushFileBuffers/CloseHandle allowlist. It does not enter write_path_ids and cannot authorize any content or metadata mutation.
governance_writer_and_access_contract.all_other_roles_rule: All inherited V4 reads, writes, metadata, membership, rename, delete, runtime dependency and process-start scopes are exact except the two named Root capabilities above.
